## What's new

- **Closing the player is smooth again.** Pulling the full player down no longer shakes: it moves as one card with your finger, with rounded corners and a shadow over the dimmed app, and carries on down when you let go.
- **Rename your servers.** In Settings → your server, swipe a server or touch and hold it and choose **Rename**. Leave the name empty to go back to the server's address.
- **Settings lists your servers once.** The card at the top opens them; the extra Servers row is gone (it only appears while you're signed out).

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux). New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kultr_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
